Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Added an editable Trip max price field to the Datacentre bargain trip controls. Bargain trips now use that trip-specific cap while active, defaulting to 7,000 gil. Normal Bargain mode still uses the fixed 7,000 gil cap unless a bargain trip is actively applying its override.
